This is a program for preparing data and training neural networks that find objects in photos (YOLO). The whole path in one window:
import → annotate → check → export → training → results.

The tour takes a minute. Arrows ← → or Enter - navigate, Esc - exit.

What the model consists of

A modern detector is a chain of blocks "convolution → activation → …": Conv looks for features, Sigmoid + Mul together give the SiLU activation, Concat/Split/Add mix streams, MaxPool/Resize change the scale. At the end everything is reduced to a list of candidate boxes.

Главный «детектор признаков»: скользящим: The main “feature detector”: a sliding window (the kernel_shape attribute) looks for edges, textures, shapes. Kernel weights are what the model has learned. The more Conv layers and channels, the “smarter” and heavier the model.
Сжимает число в диапазон 0..1. На выходе: Squeezes a number into the range 0..1. At the output it is a “probability”; inside the network, together with Mul, it forms the SiLU function.
Поэлементное умножение. В паре Conv → Si: Element-wise multiplication. The Conv → Sigmoid → Mul chain gives the SiLU activation (x·sigmoid(x)).
Поэлементная сумма. Часто - «короткая св: Element-wise sum. Often a “shortcut” (residual): the block input is added to its result so that a deep network trains stably.
Объединяет несколько потоков признаков п: Merges several feature streams along channels. This is how the network mixes information from different levels of detail.
Делит тензор на части по каналам - обрат: Splits a tensor into parts along channels - the reverse of Concat (used in C2f/C3k2 blocks).
Вырезает часть тензора (например, отдель: Cuts out part of a tensor (for example, individual channels or coordinates).
Уменьшает карту признаков в несколько ра: Shrinks the feature map several times, keeping the maximum in each window. Gives robustness to shifts; in the SPPF block it widens the “field of view”.
Увеличивает карту признаков (upsample),: Enlarges the feature map (upsample) to combine deep features with more detailed ones.
Меняет расположение данных без изменения: Rearranges data without changing values - prepares the output for the “candidates × parameters” format.
Превращает набор чисел в вероятности, су: Turns a set of numbers into probabilities that sum to 1 (used when decoding box edges).
Активация: отрицательные значения слегка: Activation: negative values are slightly attenuated instead of zeroed.
Лёгкая приближённая форма SiLU (быстрее: A light approximate form of SiLU (faster on weak hardware).
Поэлементная разность (используется при: Element-wise difference (used when computing box coordinates).
Основа механизма внимания (attention): с: The basis of the attention mechanism: the network compares parts of the image with each other to understand context. Found in the C2PSA / PSA blocks of modern YOLO.
Каждый выход считается из всех входов ср: Each output is computed from all inputs at once.
A constant value baked into the model.
Служебная операция: возвращает размеры т: Utility operation: returns the tensor dimensions.
Служебная операция: убирает размерность: Utility operation: removes a dimension of length one.
Выбирает K самых высоких оценок (отбор к: Selects the K highest scores (candidate selection in end-to-end models).
Находит максимальное значение (например,: Finds the maximum value (for example, the best class).
Номер наибольшего элемента (например, но: Index of the largest element (for example, the class index).
Усредняет карту признаков до одного числ: Averages the feature map to a single number per channel.
Выравнивает значения для стабильного обу: Evens out values for stable training (usually “fused” into Conv on export).
Добавляет рамку из нулей вокруг карты пр: Adds a border of zeros around the feature map.
Преобразует тип чисел (например, float32: Converts the number type (for example, float32 ↔ float16).
Обрезает значения до заданного диапазона: Clips values to a given range.

with open(MODEL, "rb") as f:                  # read bytes: works with non-ASCII paths too
    net = cv2.dnn.readNetFromONNX(np.frombuffer(f.read(), np.uint8))


def letterbox(img, size):
    h, w = img.shape[:2]
    r = min(size / h, size / w)
    nh, nw = int(round(h * r)), int(round(w * r))
    canvas = np.full((size, size, 3), 114, np.uint8)
    top, left = (size - nh) // 2, (size - nw) // 2
    canvas[top:top + nh, left:left + nw] = cv2.resize(img, (nw, nh))
    return canvas, r, left, top


def detect(img):
    lb, r, left, top = letterbox(img, IMGSZ)
    net.setInput(cv2.dnn.blobFromImage(lb, 1 / 255.0, (IMGSZ, IMGSZ), swapRB=True))
    out = net.forward()[0].T                    # (candidates, 4 + number of classes)
    scores = out[:, 4:]
    cls, conf = scores.argmax(1), scores.max(1)
    keep = conf >= CONF
    out, cls, conf = out[keep], cls[keep], conf[keep]
    boxes = np.c_[out[:, 0] - out[:, 2] / 2, out[:, 1] - out[:, 3] / 2, out[:, 2], out[:, 3]]   # x, y, w, h
    result = []
    if len(boxes):
        for i in np.array(cv2.dnn.NMSBoxes(boxes.tolist(), conf.tolist(), CONF, IOU)).reshape(-1):
            x, y, w, h = boxes[i]
            x1, y1 = (x - left) / r, (y - top) / r
            result.append((NAMES[cls[i]], float(conf[i]), (x1, y1, x1 + w / r, y1 + h / r)))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    img = cv2.imread(sys.argv[1])
    for name, conf, (x1, y1, x2, y2) in detect(img):
        print(f"{name} {conf:.2f} ({x1:.0f}, {y1:.0f}, {x2:.0f}, {y2:.0f})")
        cv2.rectangle(img, (int(x1), int(y1)), (int(x2), int(y2)), (0, 255, 0), 2)
        cv2.putText(img, f"{name} {conf:.2f}", (int(x1), max(12, int(y1) - 4)), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.6, (0, 255, 0), 2)
    cv2.imwrite("result.jpg", img)
